name: Dangerous Low-Level Primitive (Solidity)
attack_scenario: delegatecall runs a target's code in the caller's storage context — if the target is user-controlled it can rewrite the owner slot or selfdestruct the contract; an unguarded selfdestruct lets anyone destroy the contract and seize its balance (SWC-106/SWC-112)
negative_test_hint: call the function as a non-owner supplying an "attacker-controlled implementation address" and assert it reverts

exemplar.explanation: do not delegatecall (or forward calldata to) a caller-controlled address; invoke a fixed, audited contract through its interface behind access control, and avoid selfdestruct
